title.zh: 最小化加油站间的最大距离
title.en: Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station

desc.zh: 不去决定每座新站放哪，而是问“最长空档 D 做得到吗”，再对答案二分。
desc.en: Stop placing stations one by one: ask whether a worst gap D is achievable, then binary search the answer.

complexity: O(n·log(W/1e-6)) time, at most 47 rounds of O(n) for W ≤ 1e8 and independent of k; O(n) auxiliary space for the gap list

concepts.name: Even spacing inside a gap
concepts.description: c new stations in a gap of length g give a best longest piece of g/(c+1), so only counts per gap matter.

concepts.name: Feasibility count need(D)
concepts.description: A gap of length g needs ceil(g/D) - 1 stations; the total only rises as D shrinks, so the yes/no answer flips once.

concepts.name: Binary search on a real-valued answer
concepts.description: Keep lo impossible and hi achievable, halve until hi - lo <= 1e-6, and return hi within the accepted tolerance.
